questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by four conclusions I, II, III and IV. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem at variance from commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements:**

I. All parrots are crows.

II. All crows are robins.

III. All robins are swan.

**Conclusions:**

I. All parrots are swans.

II. All swans are crows

III. All robins are parrots.

IV. All crows are swans.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and IV follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Drawing the Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7aa06fba7d51f48cea1ef545a526b22a3f88a3e93d0ab5232e8c9087f7e6a1a.png] 

Conclusion 1: All parrots are swans → True (This is definitely true)

Conclusion 2: All swans are crows → False (Possible but not definite)

Conclusion 3: All robins are parrots → False (Possible but not definite)

Conclusion 4: All crows are swans → True (This is definitely true)

Hence, “only conclusions 1 and 4” follow.

questions.question:
In the following equation, two signs and two numbers need to be interchanged to make it correct. Select the appropriate signs and numbers from the given alternatives.

6 × 8 + 2 = 20
questions.solution:
Interchanging the numbers and symbols and using BODMAS rule,

Option 1 → + and ×, 2 and 8

6 + 2 × 8 = 20

6 + 16 is equal to 22, not 20

Option 2 → × and +, 20 and 6

20 × 8 + 2 = 6

160 + 2 is equal to 162, not 6

Option 3 → × and +, 6 and 2

2 + 8 × 6 = 20

2 + 48 is equal to 50, not 20

**Option 4 → + and ×, 6 and 8**

**8 + 6 × 2 = 20**

**8 + 12 = 20**

**20 = 20**

Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions I and II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem at variance from commonly known facts. Choose which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements:**

I. All chairs are wood.

II. No wood is furniture.

**Conclusions:**

I. All chairs are furniture.

II. Some furniture are wood.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
Drawing the Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbe3f3955bbf7ef358b7ca54d991c6ba42c6b6cf42cec28a3d4b02dd7521952f.png] 

Conclusion 1: All chairs are furniture → False (This is definitely false)

Conclusion 2: Some furniture are wood → False (This is definitely false)

Hence, “neither conclusion 1 nor conclusion 2” follow.

questions.question: If Y = 50, SEA = 50, then ‘YACHT’ will be equal to?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de149ee398cb35093e02784dcbe07f3a71665ac8fa6130a32a0e3a8e83d49946.png] 

The pattern followed is,

The place value of Y is 25, 25 + 25 = 50

And,

For,

SEA

The place value of S is 19, 19 + 19 = 38

The place value of E is 5, 5 + 5 = 10

The place value of A is 1, 1 + 1 = 2

SEA → 38 + 10 + 2 = 50

Similarly,

For,

YACHT

The place value of Y is 25, 25 + 25 = 50

The place value of A is 1, 1 + 1 = 2

The place value of C is 3, 3 + 3 = 6

The place value of H is 8, 8 + 8 = 16

The place value of T is 20, 20 + 20 = 40

YACHT → 50 + 2 + 6 + 16 + 40 = **114**

Hence, “114” is the correct answer.
